strings.@description: Operations at a date and time or repeated, also with lilOS closed: reminders, backups of folders, web requests, Terminal commands, apps' services, opening apps and files, automations.

strings.@actions.scheduler.copyFolder.label: Copy this folder…
strings.@actions.scheduler.commandHere.label: Command in this folder…
strings.@actions.scheduler.openFolder.label: Open it…
strings.@actions.scheduler.runAutomation.label: Run this automation…
strings.@actions.scheduler.openFile.label: Open this file…
strings.@actions.scheduler.remind.label: Reminder about it…

strings.@entrypoints.create.label: New operation

strings.@dependencies.scheduler.reason: Runs the operations in the kernel, also with lilOS closed
strings.app.name: Scheduler
strings.needsKernel: The Scheduler needs lilOS connected to its kernel.
strings.side.label: Filters
strings.side.browser: This runs in the browser: lilOS must be open then. If it is not, it waits for the next time you open it.
strings.col.name: Name
strings.welcome.title: Nothing scheduled yet
strings.welcome.text: An operation does something at a date and time, or again and again: a reminder, a backup of a folder, a web request, a command… also with lilOS closed.
strings.detail.label: The chosen operation
strings.detail.inKernel: In the kernel, also with lilOS closed, as {who}
strings.detail.inBrowser: In the browser, with lilOS open, as {who}
strings.detail.missedOnce: Made up once when the kernel is back
strings.detail.othersNote: It runs as {who}, with their files and connections. When you change, pause or delete it, they get a notification.
strings.delete.title: Delete «{name}»?
strings.delete.text: It will not run any more, and its history goes too.
strings.error.title: Not done
strings.history.catchup: It was due {due}: the kernel was off. {text}
strings.kind.notify.name: Reminder
strings.kind.notify.hint: A notification, maybe with a file or an app to open
strings.kind.service.name: An app's service
strings.kind.service.hint: Starts a service of the installed apps, with its values
strings.kind.copy.name: Copy a folder
strings.kind.copy.hint: A backup into another folder or into Network
strings.kind.command.name: Terminal command
strings.kind.command.hint: Shell lines in lilOS, or on a saved SSH host
strings.kind.web.name: Web request
strings.kind.web.hint: Calls an address and checks the answer
strings.kind.open.name: Open an app or a file
strings.kind.open.hint: Needs lilOS open in a tab
strings.kind.automation.name: Automation
strings.editor.proposedBy: Proposed by {app}: check it before saving.
strings.service.noParams: This service has no values to choose.
strings.service.hint: It runs in the kernel, also with lilOS closed. A service that was off starts for the run and stops after it.
strings.copy.versions: Dated versions: a new folder each time, keeping the last {keep}
strings.copy.update: Update: only the files that are new or changed, in one folder
strings.copy.mirror: Mirror: as Update, and what is gone from the source goes from the copy (into the trash, in lilOS)
strings.copy.excludeHint: Names, with * and ?, separated by commas
strings.copy.hint: The kernel copies, also with lilOS closed. The copy goes into a folder with the name of the one copied.
strings.command.placeholder: # one command per line, as in the Terminal
strings.command.hint: The Terminal's shell, in the kernel, as you. Files protected by an app (FileCrypt) are not opened here.
strings.command.sshHint: With the credentials saved in the Terminal for that host.
strings.saveTo.title: Save
strings.saveTo.web: Save the answer in a file
strings.saveTo.command: Save the output in a file
strings.saveTo.name: File name
strings.saveTo.dated: a new one with the date
strings.web.secretHint: Kept encrypted in the kernel, never shown again
strings.web.hint: The history keeps the status, the time, the headers and the first 4 KB of the answer. Addresses of the local network follow the rule of Network.
strings.open.browserHint: It needs lilOS open at that time; if it is not, it waits and asks when you open it.
strings.open.gone: The file is not there any more.
strings.automation.hint: Automata runs it in its window, with lilOS open; if it is not, it waits and asks when you open it.
strings.when.cronHint: minute hour day month weekday: «0 2 * * 0» is every Sunday at 02:00
strings.opt.name: Name
strings.opt.missed: If the kernel was off at that time
strings.opt.missedOnce: Run it once when it is back (within the hours an admin chose)
strings.opt.ask: Ask before running it when lilOS opens
strings.opt.overlap: If the time before is still running
strings.opt.systemHint: The system has no home: only reminders to the admins, services chosen for everyone and web requests without files.
strings.opt.otherHint: It runs as that person, with their files and connections; they get a notification.

strings.@description: Operazioni a una data e ora o ripetute, anche a lilOS chiuso: promemoria, copie di cartelle, richieste web, comandi del Terminale, servizi delle app, aprire app e file, automazioni.

strings.app.name: Pianificazione
strings.needsKernel: La Pianificazione ha bisogno di lilOS collegato al suo kernel.
strings.side.label: Filtri
strings.side.browser: Questa gira nel browser: a quell’ora serve lilOS aperto. Se non lo è, aspetta la prossima volta che lo apri.
strings.col.name: Nome
strings.welcome.title: Ancora niente di pianificato
strings.welcome.text: Un’operazione fa qualcosa a una data e ora, o più volte: un promemoria, la copia di una cartella, una richiesta web, un comando… anche a lilOS chiuso.
strings.detail.label: L’operazione scelta
strings.detail.inKernel: Nel kernel, anche a lilOS chiuso, come {who}
strings.detail.inBrowser: Nel browser, con lilOS aperto, come {who}
strings.detail.missedOnce: Recupera una volta appena il kernel riparte
strings.detail.othersNote: Gira come {who}, con i suoi file e le sue connessioni. Se la cambi, la metti in pausa o la elimini, riceve una notifica.
strings.delete.title: Eliminare «{name}»?
strings.delete.text: Non partirà più, e se ne va anche il suo storico.
strings.error.title: Non fatto
strings.history.catchup: Era prevista {due}: il kernel era spento. {text}
strings.kind.notify.name: Promemoria
strings.kind.notify.hint: Una notifica, anche con un file o un’app da aprire
strings.kind.service.name: Servizio di un’app
strings.kind.service.hint: Avvia un servizio delle app installate, con i suoi valori
strings.kind.copy.name: Copia una cartella
strings.kind.copy.hint: Una copia di sicurezza in un’altra cartella o in Rete
strings.kind.command.name: Comando del Terminale
strings.kind.command.hint: Righe di shell in lilOS, o su un host SSH salvato
strings.kind.web.name: Richiesta web
strings.kind.web.hint: Chiama un indirizzo e controlla la risposta
strings.kind.open.name: Apri un’app o un file
strings.kind.open.hint: Serve lilOS aperto in una scheda
strings.kind.automation.name: Automazione
strings.editor.proposedBy: Proposta da {app}: controllala prima di salvare.
strings.service.noParams: Questo servizio non ha valori da scegliere.
strings.service.hint: Gira nel kernel, anche a lilOS chiuso. Un servizio spento si accende per la corsa e si spegne dopo.
strings.copy.versions: Versioni datate: ogni volta una cartella nuova, tenendo le ultime {keep}
strings.copy.update: Aggiorna: solo i file nuovi o cambiati, in una sola cartella
strings.copy.mirror: Specchio: come Aggiorna, e quello che non c’è più va via anche dalla copia (nel cestino, se è in lilOS)
strings.copy.excludeHint: Nomi, con * e ?, separati da virgole
strings.copy.hint: Copia il kernel, anche a lilOS chiuso. La copia va in una cartella con il nome di quella copiata.
strings.command.placeholder: # un comando per riga, come nel Terminale
strings.command.hint: La shell del Terminale, nel kernel, come te. I file protetti da un’app (FileCrypt) qui non si aprono.
strings.command.sshHint: Con le credenziali salvate nel Terminale per quell’host.
strings.saveTo.title: Salva
strings.saveTo.web: Salva la risposta in un file
strings.saveTo.name: Nome del file
strings.web.secretHint: Tenuto cifrato nel kernel, non si vede più
strings.web.hint: Nello storico: stato, durata, intestazioni e i primi 4 KB della risposta. Gli indirizzi della rete locale seguono la regola della Rete.
strings.open.browserHint: A quell’ora serve lilOS aperto; se non lo è, aspetta e te lo chiede quando lo apri.
strings.automation.hint: La esegue Automata nella sua finestra, con lilOS aperto; se non lo è, aspetta e te lo chiede quando lo apri.
strings.when.cronHint: minuto ora giorno mese giorno-della-settimana: «0 2 * * 0» è ogni domenica alle 02:00
strings.opt.name: Nome
strings.opt.missed: Se a quell’ora il kernel era spento
strings.opt.missedOnce: Eseguila una volta appena riparte (entro le ore scelte dall’amministratore)
strings.opt.ask: Chiedi prima di eseguirla quando apri lilOS
strings.opt.overlap: Se la volta prima è ancora in corso
strings.opt.systemHint: Il sistema non ha una home: solo promemoria agli amministratori, servizi scelti per tutti e richieste web senza file.
strings.opt.otherHint: Gira come quella persona, con i suoi file e le sue connessioni; riceve una notifica.
